reasons.plausibility: Premelting at grain boundaries in multi-component nanoparticles is consistent with known behavior, though minor uncertainties remain about the relative role of surfaces vs. internal defects.
reasons.testability: The proposed slow vs. rapid heating experiment, combined with in situ TEM and DSC, provides a clear and decisive method to confirm or refute the localized grain-boundary melting mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses the key question of how premelting initiates in high-entropy-alloy nanoparticles and offers a straightforward approach to define their high-temperature behavior.
